main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move per case (long), cases of one day together

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, heavier half minus lighter half (median volume ratio)

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.416 (below 1), 220 cases (30 needed).
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise >= 2 points from its low since the last bet) in each 5-bar grid cell from each window's first row; the t clusters deviations by UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction; the heavier half is volume ratio above the median, the lighter half at or below it; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases or 20 days' is reported as not observable; calm is read from the detector's regime.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.416 (below 1), 220 cases (30 needed)
